Mira (product): Heads up — Acme merchant asked for tenant-level routing + per-tenant SLOs. Sales say it's a $250k ARR deal if we can commit. Can we scope an MVP that avoids heavy infra work?
Alex (eng): Quick reality check: per-tenant SLOs need per-tenant metrics and tracing plumbing. Full implementation ~3 sprints.
Priya (design): We can mock a lightweight console for routing rules and an SLO toggle. Mock ready by Wed. Error UX still TBD.
Jamal (sales): They want something before EoQ. Is there a limited "beta" we can offer so they can sign early?
Ken (eng-sre): Possible: a "soft" tenant control that uses sampling-based SLOs + existing logging. Lower risk, faster ~3 weeks, but no formal SLA.
Alex (eng): Soft controls are fine for parity signals. Important: implement fallback policy `fallback: regional-variant` so we don't route all traffic to one risky variant.
Mira (product): Product tradeoff: ship parity (full per-tenant SLOs) vs differentiated UX (customer-configurable latency tiers + alerts). We need to avoid blocking GA launches.
Priya (design): Differentiator UI (latency-tier dropdown, alert hooks) is high-impact for buyers. Could be the MVP surface while infra work runs in parallel.
Jamal (sales): They also listed audit logs + KMS integration as deal-breakers. Audit logs ok, KMS/HSM is a heavier enterprise ask.
Ken (eng-sre): We can deliver audit logs via current pipeline quickly. KMS: depends on whether they require HSM-backed keys or just KMS integration.
Alex (eng): Proposed plan: 1) Offer "Beta tenant controls" (soft SLOs + routing toggles + audit logging). 2) On signed commitment, prioritize hard SLOs + KMS in next commitment. Launch criteria: beta acceptance, no P0 regressions, SLO instrumentation in prod.
Mira (product): Agreed. Concrete launch criteria: customer sign-off on beta terms, security review complete, docs + runbook, and ingress load tests show <5% error delta.
product-bot: Action created — PRD ticket PL-432 in Notion, owner Mira, due in 7 days.
Jamal (sales): I'll get their sign-off on beta wording and draft contract changes today.
Ken (eng-sre): I'll kick off a spike next Tue to validate prefix caching + per-tenant routing effects.
Alex (eng): I'll break down engineering tasks and post a tentative timeline by EOD.
Mira (product): Thanks — syncing Mon 10am to lock scope. If we're aligned we'll slot a small roadmap slice for the next sprint and label follow-ups as "enterprise follow-up" for full SLO/KMS.
